  • Method Details

    • registerTechnique

      public static void registerTechnique(String fruitId, Technique technique)
      Registers a technique for a specific fruit. This method allows you to add a technique to a fruit's list of techniques.
      Parameters:
      fruitId - the unique identifier of the fruit
      technique - the technique to be registered

    • getNormalTechniques

      public static List<Technique> getNormalTechniques(String fruitId)
      Retrieves all normal techniques (non-ultimate) for a specific fruit.
      Parameters:
      fruitId - the unique identifier of the fruit
      Returns:
      a list of normal techniques for the specified fruit

    • getAllTechniques

      public static List<Technique> getAllTechniques(String fruitId)
      Retrieves all techniques (both normal and ultimate) for a specific fruit.
      Parameters:
      fruitId - the unique identifier of the fruit
      Returns:
      a list of all techniques for the specified fruit

    • unregisterTechnique

      public static void unregisterTechnique(String fruitId, Technique technique)
      Unregisters a technique from a specific fruit. This method allows you to remove a technique from a fruit's list of techniques.
      Parameters:
      fruitId - the unique identifier of the fruit
      technique - the technique to be unregistered

    • clearAllTechniques

      public static void clearAllTechniques()
      Clears all registered techniques for all fruits. This method removes all techniques from the registry.

    • getById

      public static Technique getById(String id)
      Retrieves a technique by its unique identifier. This method searches through all registered techniques and returns the one with the specified ID.
      Parameters:
      id - the unique identifier of the technique
      Returns:
      the technique with the specified ID, or null if not found

    • summarizeTechniques

      public static void summarizeTechniques()
      Summarizes the registered techniques for all fruits. This method logs a summary of the number of techniques, normal techniques, and ultimate techniques for each registered group.

    • summarizeGroupTechniques

      public static void summarizeGroupTechniques(org.bukkit.entity.Player p, String fruitId)

      fruitId - the unique identifier of the fruit

    • logSummaryToFile

      public static void logSummaryToFile()
      Logs a summary of all techniques per fruit group to a file that has the name of the group and the date of the summary. The file should be saved in a "technique_summaries" folder within the plugin's data folder.
